observation.visible_scene: A grayscale, soft-focus view dominated by dark leaf and branch silhouettes framing a brighter background. A straight diagonal line runs from the upper-right toward the lower-center, and a thin curved line crosses the middle-right area; both remain fixed throughout. Dark foliage masses occupy the top edge, the top-left corner, and a large cluster on the right, while bright patches of light fill the gaps between them.
visible_changes: The bright background regions continuously warp, shift, and change shape while the dark silhouettes and the two thin lines stay in place.
The central bright blob slowly drifts and elongates toward the right over the excerpt.
The lower bright areas expand, contract, and translate (e.g., the bright patch near the bottom-left and the broad bright band at the bottom-right change extent and position).
The edges of the right-side leaf cluster and the top foliage blur and undulate slightly, indicating ongoing motion of the light/shadow pattern rather than of the framing silhouettes.
No clear onset or completion is visible; the undulation is already in progress at the first frame and continues at the last.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the moving bright patches (swaying leaves, rippling reflective surface, or focus/lighting drift) is not determinable from the frames.
Whether the diagonal and curved lines are wires, branches, or their reflections is not shown.
Events before the first frame and after the last frame are unseen.
uncertain_details: It is uncertain whether the scene is direct foliage against sky or a reflection on a water-like surface; the warping bright areas are consistent with either.
Whether any camera movement is present is unclear, since the fixed dark framing suggests little to no pan/translation.
